newsitem.title: BELGIUM: UCB's Zyrtec approved for use in children.
newsitem.headline: UCB's Zyrtec approved for use in children.

text.p: Belgian drugs and chemicals group UCB said on Thursday it won approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the use of its Zyrtec anti-allergy drug on paediatric patients.
UCB said in a statement Zyrtec was the only one of recent anti-allergics to have gained marketing clearance for child patients between the ages of six and 12.
Zyrtec now has FDA approval for three indications - seasonal allergies caused by pollen, year-round allergies caused by allergens such as dust mites and molds, and hives and itching.
In the U.S. Zyrtec is jointly promoted by UCB Pharma Inc, UCB's U.S. subsidiary, and its licensee for the U.S., Pfizer Inc.
